_readme: Question set for the premise gate (app/premise_gate.py). 'refuse' questions have a premise the corpus cannot answer — every answer to them is invention, however well grounded the pieces are. 'answer' questions must reach the composer untouched; a gate that refuses one of these has made the robot useless, which is the failure mode that matters most in the other direction. Categories follow the 2026-09-12 adversarial audit: pending cases, living officials, current politics, events after the corpus ends, cases not in the corpus.

refuse.q: Who is the current Solicitor General and what did you tell them?
refuse.note: the audit's worst case — the corpus pairing is real but a year stale
